# Dorfromantik Archipelago v0.1.0

## What it does

Dorfromantik normally hands you 40 tiles and lets you earn more by placing perfectly and
completing quests. Both are switched off here. A run lasts exactly as many placements as
Archipelago has given you — when the stack empties, the run ends and you start another.
Progress carries across runs, so a bad run costs nothing but time.

You start with one terrain type. Until you receive more, the game only generates tiles for
terrain you own, and flags for terrain you don't own never appear at all.

- **Items** — Terrain tiles (Forest, Field, Village, Water, Train Track), Quest Tiles,
  generic Tile Packs, and the game's 22 tile and biome unlocks.
- **Locations** — Flags completed, counted overall, per terrain, and within a single run,
  plus score milestones.
- **Goal** — Your choice, and both are single-run achievements: reach a target score in one
  run, or complete a target number of flags in one run.

## Options

There are four, and that is deliberate. **Goal**, your target, **Skill**, and **Tiles Per
Pack**.

Skill decides how much you are given to reach your goal, and means the same thing on both
goals: how much of what you are handed you actually convert. Every figure is measured from
real play.

| Skill | Points per tile | Tiles to reach 5000 | Flags closed |
|---|---|---|---|
| easy | 25.0 | 200 | 70% |
| medium | 27.8 | 180 | 78% |
| hard | 30.3 | 165 | 87% |
| pro | 33.3 | 150 | 95% |

Everything else — deck length, flag tiles, how many checks exist — is derived from your
goal. There is no option for pool size or check count on purpose: either would compete with
the goal, and the larger number would quietly win, leaving seeds finishable long before
their items arrived.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `Dorfromantik-AP-v0.1.0.zip` | The game mod. BepInEx included — drop-in. |
| `dorfromantik.apworld` | The Archipelago world. Needs Archipelago 0.6.8+. |

## Install

**Mod** — Extract the zip into your Dorfromantik folder, next to `Dorfromantik.exe`.
That's the whole install; BepInEx ships with it, already configured.
(Steam: right-click Dorfromantik → Manage → Browse local files.)

Launch the game once and quit, which creates
`BepInEx\config\io.github.dorfromantik.archipelago.cfg`. Open it and set:

```ini
ApModeEnabled = true
Slot = your slot name
Host = your server
Port = your port
